source_brief.standout: Stepped wave profiles and changing sail outlines give a stationary pontoon a handmade voyage illusion.
source_brief.scene: A clearly DOCKED twin-hull party pontoon with cyan rail outlines, gold speaker rings and a playful finite fan of coral/violet origami-like sail contour frames attached to supported canopy posts. Below the deck are dry-stage-style illustrated light wave contours; no real rough water. Four bottom storyboard cells show low wave/calm sail, rising wave/angled sail, crest/bowed sail outline, falling wave/rest sail. Same stationary boat in every frame, replacement light shapes only.
